verdict.rationale: Inngest's source is publicly viewable on GitHub (inngest-gh-1), but community evidence explicitly states the license (SSPL) is not OSI-approved open source, calling it 'source available' and 'fauxpen source' rather than truly open licensed (inngest-comm-2, inngest-comm-11, inngest-comm-12). Missing for 10: an actual OSI-approved open-source license, first-party confirmation of licensing terms, and any docs evidence rebutting the community's characterization.
